dct_title_s: Allen Quadrangle, Minnesota-St. Louis County, 1962: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Allen quadrangle topographic map (N4730-W9200/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area between Aurora and Babbitt. The hand written notations include information on the following: Northampton & Bath Railroad line (NB); Shank logging camps noted with 'C'; Shank Lumber Company;
